sources.issuing_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
sources.description: Reconstructed curated summary of 25 core sections (definitions, CCPA powers, commission jurisdictions, product liability, penalties). NOT the complete 107-section verbatim Act.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 (G.S.R. 452(E))
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.description: Complete official Gazette Extraordinary notification containing 11 pages of Hindi & English statutory text governing e-commerce entities, marketplace duties, seller return/refund obligations, and 48hr/30d grievance timelines.

sources.title: Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, State Commission and National Commission) Rules, 2021 (G.S.R. 896(E))
sources.issuing_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
sources.description: Complete official Gazette Extraordinary notification defining revised pecuniary limits: District Commission up to Rs 50 Lakhs, State Commission Rs 50 Lakhs to Rs 2 Crores, National Commission above Rs 2 Crores.
